content.text: Executive Summary

Johnson & Johnson partnered with HumbleBeeAI to answer whether its events increase medical procedure volumes. Fragmented event, account and procedure records made it difficult to assess event effectiveness, compare regional performance or confidently evaluate return on investment. HumbleBeeAI delivered a unified analytics solution in Microsoft Power BI, designed to support event-impact analysis and interactive exploration.

attrs.chunkText: Johnson and Johnson partnered with HumbleBeeAI to answer a critical question: Do their events actually increase medical procedure volumes?. The answer came through a powerful Power BI solution. HumbleBeeAI gave J&J the ability to measure event effectiveness, compare regional performance, and prove return on investment with confidence by turning fragmented and inconsistent data into a unified analytics platform.

What began as a fragmented and frustrating data challenge became a powerful competitive advantage. Johnson and Johnson now has the ability to validate event ROI with precision, guide strategy with reliable benchmarks, and ensure every marketing investment contributes measurable value.

Through this collaboration, HumbleBeeAI demonstrated how structured analytics can transform raw information into insights that directly impact business growth. J&J is not only measuring its past events more effectively but is also building a scalable platform to guide future strategies with confidence.

HumbleBeeAI continues to help industry leaders unlock similar value from their data.

content.text: Context and Challenge

J&J invests in educational and promotional events for medical professionals, with the aim of strengthening relationships and encouraging adoption of its products. However, event activity was separated from procedure data, so teams lacked a reliable way to connect events with changes in procedure volume.

attrs.chunkText: As a global healthcare leader, Johnson and Johnson invests heavily in educational and promotional events for medical professionals. These events are designed to strengthen relationships and encourage the adoption of J&J products. But for all the resources spent, one challenge remained: could the company demonstrate a clear link between events and actual increases in procedure volume? To move beyond anecdotal feedback, J&J needed a reliable data driven solution.

J&J's teams faced major roadblocks in evaluating event performance:

Event data sat in isolation from procedure data, making impact measurement impossible.

There were no benchmarks to compare accounts with events against those without them.

Datasets were riddled with inconsistencies such as missing account codes and formatting issues, demanding hours of manual cleanup.

Regional comparisons were limited, leaving decision makers with little clarity on where utilization was strongest or weakest.

Any future solution needed to handle thousands of records smoothly while being easy enough for non technical users to explore independently.

Without a unified analytics framework, J&J could not confidently assess whether events were truly delivering value.

content.text: Solution and Capabilities
HumbleBeeAI built an analytics system around Microsoft Power BI, combining data preparation, event-impact analysis and interactive dashboards.

attrs.chunkText: HumbleBeeAI built a complete analytics system around Microsoft Power BI. The design focused on three pillars.

content.text: Data integration and preprocessing

Power Query was used to clean and merge account records, event logs and procedure data. The work included filling missing codes, resolving duplicates and correcting inconsistencies to create a single dataset for analysis.

attrs.chunkText: The first challenge was data quality. Using Power Query, HumbleBeeAI cleaned and merged account records, event logs, and procedure data. Missing codes were filled, duplicates resolved, and inconsistencies corrected. The result was a single reliable dataset that eliminated hours of manual effort and created a trustworthy foundation for analysis.

content.text: Event-impact analysis

The analysis compared procedure volumes before and after events at account level, established benchmarks by contrasting event-hosting accounts with non-event accounts, and mapped utilization geographically to help identify where events appeared to be working or not.

attrs.chunkText: With clean data, the team introduced multiple analytical perspectives inside Power BI. Procedure volumes before and after events were compared to calculate growth at the account level. Benchmarks were established by contrasting event hosting accounts with non event accounts. Utilization was mapped geographically, giving leaders a clear picture of where events were working and where they were not.

content.text: Interactive dashboards

Stakeholders could filter dashboard views by account, event type, procedure or timeframe and drill into the data without requiring technical support, supporting quicker exploration and strategy adjustments.

attrs.chunkText: Finally, HumbleBeeAI delivered sleek and dynamic dashboards. Stakeholders could filter by account, event type, procedure, or timeframe and immediately see the results. This interactivity allowed them to drill into the data at any level, uncover insights quickly, and adapt strategies on the fly without needing technical support.

content.text: Results and Business Impact

The case study reports improved visibility into event ROI and procedure-volume patterns, and describes the resulting benchmarks as showing that accounts hosting events consistently outperformed those that did not. It also reports that leaders could use the analysis to inform resource allocation and refine underperforming strategies.

attrs.chunkText:
The impact of the Power BI solution was transformative:

J&J gained clear visibility into event ROI, identifying accounts where procedure volumes rose directly after events.

Leaders could now make data driven decisions, reallocating resources toward high growth regions and refining underperforming strategies.

Concrete performance benchmarks proved that accounts hosting events consistently outperformed those that did not.

Manual cleaning work was eliminated, saving countless hours and freeing teams to focus on strategy.

Data accuracy and reliability improved significantly thanks to structured mapping and consistent calculations.

Stakeholders across the company felt empowered by intuitive dashboards that encouraged exploration and insight discovery.
